channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Seino Holdings works with rivals for better, cleaner transportation
item.description: In Japan’s logistics industry, companies have maintained independent delivery networks, with trucks from multiple companies operating in the same areas. In addition, due to smaller shipments and underused return trips, the “loading efficiency” of freight vehicles has remained at around 40% of what they could carry for the past 15 years or so. This is not only inefficient, but also hinders efforts to reduce carbon dioxide emissions in the industry.

item.title: Japanese bonds rally across curve as domestic stocks surge
item.description: The benchmark 10-year yield led the moves, falling 7 basis points to 2.715%. Five-year debt fell 5.5 basis points to 2.125%.

item.title: Japan holds second consular meeting with reporter detained by Russia
item.description: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi demanded the reporter's immediate release during recent brief talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen.

item.title: Chubu Electric faces tough road ahead following data scandal
item.description: It faces an uphill battle to regain public trust after it was found to have manipulated earthquake risk data at its Hamaoka nuclear power plant.

item.title: India pledges $1.6bn to Nepal in reset of ties
item.description: As Nepal rebuilds after deadly floods, its prime minister sets contentious issues aside to secure Indian funding, port access and a new train service.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
